admission.description: A pool symbol may be entered on trading day D only if every condition holds, using information available before D's open.
admission.pool_member: symbol is in the V8 pool usable on D (docs/specs/V8_POOL_PIT2021_20261007.json: tech members of the latest month whose available_at <= D, or a fixed ETF)
admission.adv20_definition: median of regular-session dollar volume (raw close x raw volume) over the 20 trading days before D; at least 10 of those days must have bars
admission.bar_status: D's bar coverage status is 'ok' (not partial, missing or post-delisting)
admission.events: no position may be held across a series break in nn_meta/validation/v8-data-20261008-r0/events.json; the break date is not admitted

execution.note: Opening half-hour spreads run about 2x the midday level (13.9 bp at 09:45 vs 5-7 bp after 11:00).

costs.description: Every simulated stock fill pays half the measured quoted spread (by price bucket, time of day and year, times a per-name factor) from nn_meta/validation/v8-spreads-stock-20261008-r0; V8.0-fills defines the table. Stage-1 pass rules also require survival at 1.5x costs.

options: Option admission cutoffs (spread cap 3-5% of mid, open interest, volume, price floor) are frozen at stage 3, not here.
